headline: Yum! Brands (YUM) Is Up 6.5% After Pizza Hut Exit And Strong Q2 Earnings - What's Changed
summary: Yum! Brands recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$2,169 million and net income of US$853 million, while also reaching definitive agreements to sell its Pizza Hut business and concluding a portfolio review aimed at sharpening focus on its remaining brands. The company’s decision to exit Pizza Hut, alongside strong earnings and a food-safety setback at Taco Bell, highlights how portfolio reshaping, operational execution and brand risks are all converging for...

headline: Microsoft's Cloud Blowout Powers Nasdaq, Then Apple And Amazon Split The Megacap Trade All Over Again
summary: The Nasdaq closed 2.8% higher on Thursday as Microsoft's Q4 blowout answered the AI-capex sceptics and dragged the entire cloud complex with it. After the bell, Amazon delivered another AWS acceleration while Apple's soft guidance sent the stock into an ugly after-hours print. PCE inflation cooled, Q2 GDP slowed, and the Fed sat still.
